Experiment 7: Binary Constraint Axes — llama3.1:8b

9 questions × 6 binary axes × 2 values each. Tests which simple, binnable parameters produce the strongest geometric separation.

Each subplot shows one binary constraint axis. Color separates A vs B values. If clusters form distinct groups, that axis has strong geometric effect.
